blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Vicente Sotto Memorial Medical Center (VSMMC) has proposed a P2.2-billion budget for 2027 to sustain its specialty centers and expand services as a Level 3 apex hospital. VSMMC chief Dr. Gerardo Aquino Jr. said the proposed allocation would support the hospital’s operations and its delivery of specialized medical care to patients in Central Visayas. The Cebu City-based government hospital is tasked to operate and establish 17 specialty centers, including those for cancer, heart diseases, and orthopedic conditions, Aquino said.
